needs.premise: One existing invocation, four logical argument identities, zero/one required argument, real rest list ordering and vector-slot completion, one raw borrow/pre-close writer, pending exit, exclusive scan/normal/exit claims and epochs0/1; physical capacity, complete ingress/root census, generated map and coherent C atomics remain premises; nonexhaustive, no native execution or liveness proof

36 conditional declarations: argument/pair conservation, pop-prepend order, completion-word arithmetic, rest/frame/borrow/generation eligibility, canonical response preservation and exclusive scan/normal/exit Authority Step/Trace; not all QNT actions, actual C frame decoding or ABI/source simulation

Source chain GET_REST -> handler7 -> finish remaining CONS -> fully initialize packed vector -> two-argument Scheme helper -> save R0/proc/args and install return frame -> FRAME_STORE_RA/W_ALL -> actual GC; first W_ALL calls noncollecting heap_limit before repair and is ineligible for park; generated RestConstructionPlan binds exact progress, complete-frame PointId/FrameSpec and scan map, not arbitrary partial C stack locals

Reserve a construction lease before destructive argument pops; no collecting/reentrant call while partial argument stack/vector lacks complete scan layout; keep partial rest, remaining/required arguments, proc/temp1 and original continuation under exclusive source custody; transfer proc/packed-vector to generated register/frame roots before local scope ends; collector-updateable cells and fresh post-GC handle reload, plus marker/native ancestor roots; all-domain RC/raw alias integration remains open

Close new native root borrowers and writers under same registry cut; pre-close writer remains counted through its actual final effect, then materialize matching root generation; relevant borrowed moving values must drain or use admitted stable handles, native-only argv/code/result backing can remain leased; a queued/issued store cannot be revoked by entry closure; late write after receipt invalidates protocol and requires exclusion proof, unknown result retains source duty and blocks receipt

FrameReady after full vector initialization, full mapped Scheme call frame, RA/GVM spill, exact root generation and native-frame/capacity lease precedes release-published offer; source pins until canonical VM accept, lost ACK does not restore old authority; one park attempt owns scan/resume/exit arbitration; offer is not scanner permission; no side-effecting rollback or duplicate constructor from unknown acceptance

After scan/root readers drain, whole-round/capacity result, context preparation, same live owner binding and relocated-root reload, claim exactly one normal or exit authority in next epoch; normal branch reloads the same packed vector and proc, restores np arguments, sets nargs=-1 and jumps target, so GET_REST cannot rebuild the rest list; same original native invocation/catcher continues, no replay or helper-thread longjmp

Ordinary exception/continuation request during unscannable repair is latched until mandatory bounded completion and root handoff; do not call arbitrary Scheme handler in partial-frame zone; after scan/round readiness atomically choose normal resume only without pending exit, or generated same-owner exit guard only with pending exit, never both; current heap-overflow helper may raise and retry GC while retaining proc/args; request epochs and park attempts must not consume a stale receipt; unmanaged asynchronous nonlocal escape/dead stack is rejected, not silently translated to managed cancel

Preflight physically reserves repair words, stack/frame and root/control metadata before pops; close new native writer/borrow admission, settle actual old final effects, complete vector and FrameSpec/GVM writes, release-publish offer, canonical accept/acquire scan; scanner writes release before whole-round/context/binding/acquire reload; exclusive fresh normal/exit claim prevents late scan and duplicate nargs resume; all raw aliases share the cut; no locks held across owner/GC wait; actual C atomic layout, helper visibility and native ABI refinement remain open

ParticipatingParkReceipt requires a generated SafePointSpec with return PointId, FrameSpec and initialized-field map after all relevant writes, complete continuation frame and register/saved/native root materialization; ___W_ALL is module/procedure-specific GVM state transfer, not arbitrary C stack scanning; rest/keyword construction calls W_ALL before complete frames are built, so that location cannot issue a receipt; retain Scheme completion plan or reject until scan-safe

Freeze root topology, writer admission and backing lifetime, not immutable SCMOBJ values; collector owns updateable canonical root cells while owner is parked; include continuation/frame map, registers, saved/type-cache/processor roots, all RC domains, generated native handles, marker and construction roots; publish after last writer and permit release, scan only after canonical VM acceptance; nonzero RC scan and raw cached SCMOBJ aliases remain open source obligations

Retain the existing native invocation stack/catcher/code/result/input envelope, but reconcile every GC-relevant effect, raw root borrower, helper and nested activation before park; closing entry cannot revoke issued stores; native-only external operation may remain active only under separately proved no-managed-access and no-GC-critical-wait profile, not by renaming its count zero; unqualified or unknown relevant operation retains source debt and blocks receipt

Source retains root/native/pool custody through Prepare and Offer; canonical VM accept under scan/resume exclusion transfers control responsibility and signs identity-bound ParticipatingParkReceipt for same live activation, park attempt, epoch, SafePointSpec, root view, borrow census and native-frame lease; release/acquire publication precedes scanning; lost acceptance ACK is resolved by protected canonical query, never permit restoration, task replay or disposal

Resume same native invocation only after scan claim/release, whole strong/weak/cleanup/capacity result, context preparation, exact same live native owner/VM incarnation binding and relocated-root reload; scan claim and resume claim share atomic state arbitration; acquire fresh next-epoch write permit before resumed managed access, retire old scan capability and root view only after readers drain; notification, receipt ACK or GC request alone does not authorize reentry

Owner closes new admission under shared registry exclusion; last relevant effect/borrow completion and generated materialization precede release-published root-view offer, canonical park acceptance and acquire scan claim; collector root updates precede release scan completion and owner acquire reload; whole-round context/binding precede fresh epoch permit and resume claim; scan claim, cancellation/exit and resume arbitrate on one canonical state, no mutex held while awaiting owner/GC callback; actual C layout, lock order, weak-memory and raw adapter coverage remain open

nodes.labelText: Real rest entry\nGET_REST / native callback envelope
Reserve physical repair + root lease\nclose new relevant writers / borrowers
CONS remaining args in order\nno collection or managed handler
Initialize every vector slot\nproc + completed args packet
Scheme helper full frame\nR0/proc/args + map + RA/W_ALL
Publish exact rooted frame generation\nsource pins until canonical accept
VM accepts same park attempt\nscan / exit / resume arbitration
Collector updates root cells\nrelease scan/readers + whole round
Context prepare + same owner bind\nreload relocated proc / vector
Fresh next epoch normal OR exit claim\nnargs=-1 / same native call
Native stack/catcher/root/code custody\ntransfer is not disposal
Unknown write / capacity / dead frame\nretain source or canonical VM debt
SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean\nsource and native-order gaps open

callers.actualChain: f3 . a returns list containing a; run-f3 calls with zero to four args; retained expected C contains generic GET_REST
callers.hazard: Expected C is static source, not current-host build or proof that every specialized call takes generic/slow entry
callers.replacement: Use f3(0..3 logical ids) as bounded real contract, both generic dispatch and heap-limit trigger conditional

callers.actualChain: Button command make-setter closure calls tcl; procedure arguments are exported, scheme_call_cmd -> tcltk_call -> apply invokes closure -> tcltk#tcl command . args
callers.hazard: Generic rest slow path may be specialized away and GC pressure not forced; borrowed argv and original native frame still alive
callers.replacement: Source-reachable callback/rest composition, not a recorded native execution; preserve synchronous result and stack

callers.actualChain: targ-gen-label-entry derives required/optional/rest dispatch; GET_REST puts target in temp1 and jumps handler for nonnegative nargs
callers.hazard: Rest reconstruction would repeat if restored nargs treated as fresh count
callers.replacement: RestConstructionPlan separates original generic entry and resume sentinel; conditional source admission

callers.actualChain: handler7 reads np/na, pushes register args; insufficient nargs shifts operator/args and tail raises wrong-nargs exception
callers.hazard: Raw pending argument stack is not a complete continuation frame
callers.replacement: Keep source construction lease and separate wrong-arity exit plan before rest pops

callers.actualChain: CONS pops last pending arg and prepends it to local rest_param_list; decrements i
callers.hazard: Unregistered C local list and partial stack cannot be frozen as if W_ALL covered them
callers.replacement: Preserve pending-prefix plus built-suffix order and one pair per rest arg under noncollecting construction lease

callers.actualChain: W_ALL -> heap_limit -> R_ALL; heap_limit adjusts msection/context or returns need-GC; actual GC is later
callers.hazard: Replacing this helper with implicit GC/callback would expose unrooted locals/incomplete frames
callers.replacement: Keep no-collection/no-managed-reentry effect contract; full helper/transitive origin proof remains open

callers.actualChain: On need-GC finish every remaining CONS before any GC; bounded by actual args; no repeated limit check inside tail
callers.hazard: Fudge constant alone does not prove enough physical words for all remaining pairs and vector
callers.replacement: Preflight RepairCapacityReceipt with remaining*(2+PAIR_BODY)+np+VECTOR_BODY and actual physical interval; refuse before destructive start if unqualified

callers.actualChain: Write vector header and last slot rest; pop required args into prior slots; END_ALLOC advances hp; push target and vector
callers.hazard: Header publication or hp change is not fully initialized vector/root transfer
callers.replacement: Keep no-park region through all np fields; publish typed completed packet only after initialized slots complete

callers.actualChain: Helper stores R0,R1,R2 at stack slots1,2,3, installs return label2, adjusts fp by8 and calls gc-without-exceptions; return descriptor fs5/link0/gcmap7
callers.hazard: Pushing proc/vector or completing vector alone is not a complete spill/frame receipt
callers.replacement: FrameReady after actual call frame plus RA/W_ALL spill; verify current generator maps separately from retained C specimen

callers.actualChain: mark_frame scans gcmap slots from1, mark_continuation decodes return metadata; gc helper saves RA/W_ALL and reloads after actual GC
callers.hazard: Frozen SCMOBJ value copies or native raw aliases become stale after collector updates cells
callers.replacement: Canonical updateable frame/register/native root handles plus post-copy reload

callers.actualChain: Resume pops proc/vector, pushes vector fields in order, loads register args, jumps target with nargs=-1; GET_REST requires nargs>=0
callers.hazard: Reentering ordinary native wrapper or generic nargs would reconstruct list and duplicate effects
callers.replacement: Resume same packet and target after fresh epoch claim; zero new rest pairs due to resume

callers.actualChain: GC overflow raises heap-overflow exception; returning handler retries with retained proc/args; nonreturn uses continuation exit
callers.hazard: Overflow is not successful resume or permission to reinitialize packed args
callers.replacement: Retain packet roots through handler/retry; model one chosen round only, cross-round attempt freshness remains open

callers.actualChain: SFUN conversion/marker/call, marker kill and Tcl delete release distinct resources
callers.hazard: Closing borrow admission does not revoke in-flight raw data_rc accesses or native result/code aliases
callers.replacement: All-domain native root/borrow handles, exact same stack/catcher and final access completion; unknown duty retained

callers.actualChain: Owned callback dequeues before execute; publisher touches PSTATE after unlock; RC root cell scanned by address only P0 branch
callers.hazard: Empty queue or pointer generation does not exclude old writers/claimed callbacks or cover nonzero RC roots
callers.replacement: Import complete writer/borrow census and all-domain adapter; accepted receipt must match last root generation

callers.actualChain: Native call installs catcher; Scheme return tests processor/live marker and throws to own catcher; propagation may escape
callers.hazard: Exit during scan could destroy root/stack backing; completed inner callback not outer native stop
callers.replacement: Latch managed exit then same-owner guard after reader/round readiness; one terminal claim; raw forced longjmp rejects profile

callers.actualChain: Strong/weak/cleanup/resize result then prepare fp/hp/limits, GC notice earlier; binding/resize cleanup have separate lifetime
callers.hazard: Scan done, notification or failed/unknown join cannot recreate live original native stack
callers.replacement: Whole-round/context/binding/root reload and fresh epoch permission; death/unknown owner retains debt and forbids same-call resume
